description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002071
DOCKET NO. F00117926
PLAINTIFF – INSOURCE EAST PROPERTIES, INC.
DEFENDANTS- PHILIP A. RIZZO, HIS HEIRS, DEVISEES AND PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVES AND HIS, HER, OR ANY OF THEIR SUCCESSORS IN RIGHT, TITTLE AND INTEREST; KENNETH RIZZO, HEIR; KREN WEINZETL; WADE WEINZETL; TD BANK USA NA A/K/A TARGET NATIONAL BANK; STATE OF NEW JERSEY; UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 21st DAY OF October 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of UNION, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 26 BLOCK 4209
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
1069 OVERLOOK TERRACE UNION, NJ
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 60.50 x 100
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Vauxhall Road
Upset price: $399,900.00 plus any commission assigned by the sheriff. *Note, this upset price is subject to increase as of the date of the sale and you will need to contact the sheriff or plaintiff’s counsel for the upset as it exists on the date of sale. This upset amount may also be subject to further Orders for Additional Sums.
Occupancy: Said property is occupied.
*Taxes —at time of inquiry — taxes paid through 3rd quarter 2026;
*Water - private account, verification of same prohibited without authorization of record property owner
*Sewer — at the time of inquiry - $46.03 open and past due from 5/14/26 + interest through payoff;
(XX) Subject to: If property is located in a Homeowner's Association, then it is sold subject to any assessments and other fees which may be responsibility of new owner under NJ Supreme
Court case of Highland Lakes Country Club & Community Association v. Franzino, 186 N.J. 99 (2006); (XX) Subject to: If property is located in a Condominium Association, then it may be sold subject to a 6month limited priority lien of the condo association;
(XX) Subject to: * If the subject property is pan of an age restricted community, you must be 55 and older and intend to reside in the property or you may be precluded membership in the Community.
*Also subject to subsequent taxes, water and sewer plus interest through date of payoff
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and nay person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, any file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4164-3 and stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an Order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $423,341.15 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: September 16, 2026
ROMANO & GARUBO
52 NEWTON AVE
P.O. BOX 456
WOODBURY, NJ 08096
